orchestrator.description: Coordinates the development workflow. Understands project state, delegates tasks to specialized agents, respects dependencies. Use when starting new work, planning sprints, or coordinating multi-agent tasks.

core-agent.description: Handles SQL dump parsing, extraction logic, SQL generation, core domain types, and per-engine dialect compatibility (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL). Use for SQL parser work, core library changes, and domain type modifications.

cli-agent.description: Handles CLI interface, commands, input/output, validation, and error messages. Use for all CLI-related implementation and changes.

web-agent.description: Handles the Next.js web application, UI components, upload flow, database/table selection, extraction UI, download flow, accessibility, and responsive design. Use for all web interface work.

integration-agent.description: Handles connecting core with CLI and Web, package boundaries, shared types, build configuration, workspace configuration, and integration tests. Use for cross-package work and build setup.

security-agent.description: Handles security review, privacy review, SQL injection concerns, malicious dump handling, path traversal, unsafe file handling, sensitive data exposure, logging safety, secret detection, and dependency risks. Use for all security and privacy validation.

qa-agent.description: Handles test strategy, unit tests, integration tests, edge cases, regression testing, build validation, type checking, and linting. Use for test creation, test reviews, and quality assurance.

opensource-agent.description: Handles README, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, CHANGELOG, LICENSE guidance, repository hygiene, public release readiness, documentation quality, and sensitive-data audit. Use for documentation and open-source preparation.
